2608.04962.title: SpecRoll: Fast-Slow Verifier-Feedback Adaptation for Speculative Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
2608.04962.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but autoregressive rollout generation remains a major efficiency bottleneck. Speculative decoding can accelerate generation, yet applying it during RL is difficult because the target policy continually evolves: static proposers become stale, while frequent drafter updates add substantial overhead. We introduce SpecRoll, a speculative rollout engine that preserves the target model's sampling distribution while adapting at two timescales. Lightweight future-token heads generate parallel proposals, while our proposed Reflex module uses delayed verifier feedback to perform bounded, trajectory-local hidden-state corrections without backpropagation. A complementary slow path updates the head parameters only when sustained degradation is detected. SpecRoll combines these mechanisms with concurrency-aware sparse-tree verification and exact target verification, leaving the target rollout distribution and GRPO objective unchanged. Across five models ranging from 1.5B to 14B and three mathematical reasoning datasets, SpecRoll achieves 1.26-2.15x generation speedup and 1.21-2.04x end-to-end speedup over vanilla GRPO. It also outperforms FastGRPO in both generation and end-to-end time across all 15 matched settings, with an average pairwise end-to-end gain of 1.18x. Controlled ablations show that the fast and slow adaptation paths provide complementary benefits. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecRoll-26062006.
2608.04962.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）後訓練改善了大型語言模型的推理能力，但自回歸展開生成仍然是一個主要的效率瓶頸。推測解碼可以加速生成，但在 RL 過程中應用它是困難的，因為目標策略不斷演變：靜態提議者變得過時，而頻繁的草擬者更新則增加了相當大的開銷。我們介紹了 SpecRoll，一個推測展開引擎，它在兩個時間尺度上適應的同時保持目標模型的取樣分佈。輕量級的未來標記頭生成並行提議，而我們提出的 Reflex 模塊利用延遲的驗證者反饋進行有界的、軌跡本地的隱藏狀態修正，而無需反向傳播。一條互補的慢路徑僅在檢測到持續的退化時更新頭部參數。SpecRoll 將這些機制與考慮並發的稀疏樹驗證和精確的目標驗證相結合，保持目標展開分佈和 GRPO 目標不變。在五個模型中，範圍從 1.5B 到 14B，以及三個數學推理數據集，SpecRoll 實現了 1.26-2.15 倍的生成加速和 1.21-2.04 倍的端到端加速，超過了原始的 GRPO。在所有 15 個匹配設置中，它在生成和端到端時間上均優於 FastGRPO，平均成對端到端增益為 1.18 倍。控制的消融實驗顯示，快速和慢速適應路徑提供了互補的好處。我們的源代碼可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecRoll-26062006 獲得。
